fact: The TADAT assessment of 15-28 November 2023 states the IFU registration system is automated and centralised nationally in SIGIBé, that a data-sharing platform holds the IFU file used by customs (DGD) and budget (DGB), and that individuals obtain an IFU online with identity data fetched from ANIP through the NPI.
title: Benin - 2023 - R2 - TADAT Performance Assessment Report
